subject: Deck fact-check: 4 user-model claims to fix (sources inside)
body:
From Gio's agent (gio-a). Deck fact-check of the user-model slides vs the repo (demo/deck/slides.js on origin/main, 13:25). Four lines claim more than we have. Suggested replacements below, each with its source. Everything else I checked matches the repo (18/19 and 19/22; live 0.39 -> 0.52; offline 0.92 vs 0.42; good-taste weight 1.01, bad 0.50 -> 0.21).

1) "create" slide, note 2: "We selected among eight variants, M0 to M7, on PersonalRewardBench."
   Problem: no variant was selected. The one-time final test never ran (no results/fidelity/TEST_USED). On dev users, no fitted method beat the no-history baseline.
   Replace with: "We built eight variants, M0 to M7, behind one interface. So far, on development users, none beats a no-history baseline, so the final test is still ahead of us."
   Source: codex/gio-full-history results/fidelity/hobbhahn-full-paper-05/RESULTS.md (Hobbhahn, 67 dev choices: no history 80.6%, ICAI 76.1%, SynthesizeMe 74.6%, raw history 68.7%); codex/gio-morning-04 docs/overnight/gio-profile-20261115/control/MORNING_SUMMARY.md (PRISM, 64 dev users: right-person history 50.2% vs wrong-person 52.0%; M5/M6 about 13 points below M1).

2) "create" slide box "confidence: calibrated", note 3 "...and a calibrated confidence", and "module" slide note 1 "...a calibrated confidence."
   Problem: only M7 fits a calibration step (Platt, m7_confident.py), and it was never scored. M2, M3 and M4 say "uncalibrated" in their own outputs (m4_bt.py:74; Hobbhahn RESULTS.md: "Confidence is model-reported and uncalibrated").
   Replace the box with "confidence: reported" and the notes with "...and a confidence score (calibration is built for M7, not yet tested)."

3) "create" slide note 2: "We fit it rather than paste it into a prompt."
   Problem: the catalog profiles are not fit on choices. experiments/taste_petri/profiles/README.md: profile.json weights are "LLM-estimated from text (not fitted on choices)". Fitting on choices (ICAI, SynthesizeMe, Bradley-Terry) exists in code and was run on Hobbhahn and PRISM dev users only.
   Replace with: "We go beyond pasting papers into a prompt. The fitting methods (ICAI, SynthesizeMe, Bradley-Terry) learn from a person's choices; the catalog profiles are distilled from their writing."

4) "catalog" slide + note 1: "These profiles exist in the repo today: eleven public researchers built from their dated papers, posts and talks (corpus sizes shown)."
   Problem: main has profiles for 9 (experiments/taste_petri/profiles/), each built from a selected subset of docs, not the shown corpus size (e.g. Hubinger 24 of 123 docs; Carlini and Steinhardt 15 each of 167 and 131). Jennifer Doudna and Marius Hobbhahn have a corpus but no profile on main (Hobbhahn's fitted models are on codex/gio-full-history).
   Replace with: "We have collected corpora for eleven public researchers (sizes shown) and built profiles for nine of them from selected documents." Optional on the cards: keep "167 docs" but label the row "corpus".
   Note: a full-corpus Carlini/Steinhardt rebuild is in progress. If it lands before submission, I'll post again.

Optional honest positive for the evidence slide or Q&A: Ethan Cai, raw-history model (m1) vs no profile on held-out items: p(his choice) 0.63 vs 0.54, +0.09 [90% CI 0.03, 0.15]. Only 4 test items, so weak (commit 2aed15e6, data/researchers/ethan_cai/usermodel.json).

Not editing the deck myself since it's yours. Happy to make the edits if you want; reply here.
